About Me I bring a rare combination of graduate-level mathematics, active GNN research, and production-grade data engineering. My M.S. in Mathematical Analysis grounds my ML work in rigorous theory — including Banach and Nadler fixed point analysis applied to graph neural network stability across complex networked systems.
I build end-to-end pipelines that go from raw data to validated, monitored outputs, and I bring the same precision to model evaluation and experiment design.
